sources.title: RS14 Rifle-/Pistol Powder, datasheet with reloading data
sources.methodNote: Page 2 heads its columns "V5 m/s" and "Pressure bar"; the temperature study labels its row "Pmax" with an SD over 10 shots. No transducer, test barrel standard or laboratory is named. The article (reload-swiss.com, "RS14 rifle calibre", February 2024) labels the same figures "Pmax mean value" and does not state the method either.

sources.title: Western Powders Handloading Guide, Edition 8.0
sources.laboratory: Western Powders, Inc. ballistics test facilities
sources.methodNote: Printed page 20: "generated at the ballistics test facilities of Western Powders, Inc. in accordance with SAAMI ... guidelines. All loads were fired through test barrels." The pressure section: "Modern ballistic labs use piezoelectric transducers to measure pressure in pounds per square inch." Shot counts, temperature and the averaging are not given.

sources.title: M1 Garand Service Rifle Load Data
sources.methodNote: Column "PSI/CUP" beside each pressure: by the trade's convention psi rows are piezoelectric and CUP rows copper crusher, but the sheet states no method, barrel, case, temperature or shot count.

sources.title: Subsonic Rifle Load Data
sources.methodNote: Each pressure is followed by "PSI", "CUP" or "N/A"; no method, barrel, case, temperature or shot count is stated.
